def lower_boundary_test(cid, points):
    ref = scene.box("KEEP")
    b = scene.box(cid)
    qr = geom.to_box_coordinates(points, ref)
    qb = geom.to_box_coordinates(points, b)
    road = points.semantic_labels == 10
    low_body = (points.semantic_labels == 9) & (qr[:,2] < -1.1)
    # Compare a box's bottom at the XY of each actual return; no plane completion.
    normal = b.rotation[:,2]
    bottom_center = b.center - normal * b.size_lwh[2]/2
    bottom_at_xy = bottom_center[2] - ((points.xyz[:,:2]-bottom_center[:2]) @ normal[:2])/normal[2]
    out = {}
    for name, mask in [("road", road), ("low_body", low_body)]:
        footprint = np.all(np.abs(qb[:,:2]) <= b.size_lwh[:2]/2, axis=1)
        rows = []
        for i in np.flatnonzero(mask):
            rows.append({"point_id": int(points.point_ids[i]),
                         "ref_local_xyz": np.round(qr[i],3).tolist(),
                         "global_z": float(points.xyz[i,2]),
                         "bottom_minus_return_global_z": float(bottom_at_xy[i]-points.xyz[i,2]),
                         "in_xy_footprint": bool(footprint[i])})
        out[name] = rows
    return out

details = []
for i, pid in enumerate(low_row.point_ids):
    p = low_row.xyz[i]
    dxy = np.linalg.norm(road_w.xyz[:,:2] - p[:2], axis=1)
    j = np.argsort(dxy)[:3]
    db = np.linalg.norm(upper_w.xyz-p, axis=1)
    jb = np.argsort(db)[:3]
    details.append({
        "point_id": int(pid), "xyz": p.tolist(),
        "truck_probability": float(low_row.semantic_probs[i,9]),
        "nearest_road": [{"point_id": int(road_w.point_ids[k]), "xy_distance": float(dxy[k]),
                         "row_minus_road_z": float(p[2]-road_w.xyz[k,2])} for k in j],
        "nearest_upper_truck": [{"point_id": int(upper_w.point_ids[k]), "distance": float(db[k])}
                                for k in jb]
    })
e_ownership = report("Low row ownership: actual road/body neighbors, without surface completion",
                     details, point_ids=wide.point_ids,
                     evidence_sources=["LIDAR_CURRENT","S0","D0"],
                     candidate_ids=cids)

print("E3 source checks", lower_cmp["source_checks"])

                          span_m=5.5, image_size=900)
for cid in ["KEEP", "TRACK_TO_DET:14"]:

                    highlight_ids=low_row.point_ids,
